channel.title: RealHunt: new homes
channel.description: New homes on RealHunt, checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.

item.title: €159,575 · Characterful 4-bedroom house with pool and views in Beaulieu-sur-Sonnette, Charente
item.description: Beaulieu-sur-Sonnette, Charente, Poitou-Charentes. 199 m². RealHunt score 84. This is a characterful old four-bedroom house in a hilly village in Charente, Poitou-Charentes. It offers 199 m² of living space across 7 rooms, including 4 bedrooms and 1 shower room, plus a fitted kitchen. The 8,708 sq ft plot has a swimming pool, a garage, a parking space and views over the surrounding countryside. The house has oil-fired central heating and a separate equipped kitchen. Asking €159,575, about €802/m².

item.title: €168,500 · Stone house with garden and wood-burning stove in Angliers, Vienne
item.description: Angliers, Vienne. 165 m². RealHunt score 81. Stone house retaining its period character, with 165 m² of living space and two bedrooms. The living room has a wood-burning stove insert and a mezzanine, and a large conservatory opens onto the kitchen and dining area. The ground floor also holds a primary bedroom suite with bathroom and shower, a WC, and a home office with shower room and WC, while an additional bedroom is upstairs. Outside, the 780 m² garden has numerous trees, two garden sheds and a well, and the conservatory has views over it. Heating is electric. Asking €168,500, about €1,021/m².

item.title: €159,000 · Fully renovated 4-bedroom house with garden and garage in Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente
item.description: Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Charente. 147 m². RealHunt score 83. This fully renovated house was completed in 2024 with a new roof. The ground floor has a 34 sqm living and dining room, a fitted kitchen, an office, a utility room and a 30 sqm veranda, and upstairs are four bedrooms and a bathroom. Outside there is a garden, a 19 sqm garage with an electric door, a 13 sqm garden shed and an 11 sqm outbuilding on 17,244 sq ft of land. Gas boiler heating and a new wood-burning stove in the living room. Asking €159,000, about €1,082/m².

item.title: €161,000 · Spacious 4-bedroom townhouse with terrace and cellar in Bergerac, Dordogne
item.description: Bergerac, Dordogne. 160 m². RealHunt score 82. Spacious 160 m2 townhouse in the centre of Bergerac, with all shops within walking distance. The ground floor has an entrance hall, cellar and utility room, while the first floor holds a fitted kitchen, living room, 2 bedrooms, bathroom, shower room and WC. The top floor adds 2 bedrooms, storage rooms, a hallway, a shower room and a WC. The kitchen opens onto a terrace, and the property includes 1,733 sq ft of land. It has a new mains gas boiler, double glazing, electric shutters and mains drainage. Asking €161,000, about €1,006/m².

item.title: €159,000 · Fully renovated 4-bedroom house with basement and garage in Junay, Burgundy
item.description: Junay, Burgundy. 164 m². RealHunt score 83. This fully renovated house is ready to move into now. It has four bedrooms, two on the main level and two upstairs, plus a fitted kitchen and a large reception room of nearly 60 m² with a wood stove insert. Extras include a balcony, a full basement with garage area and cellar, and a separate garage with inspection pit and workshop. Land covers 11,388 sq ft. Heating is central oil-fired with a condensing boiler, plus reversible heat-pump air conditioning and double glazing. Asking €159,000, about €970/m².

item.title: €159,000 · Fully renovated 3-bedroom village house with roof terrace and views in Cruzy, Hérault
item.description: Cruzy, Languedoc, Hérault. 158 m². RealHunt score 86. This fully renovated village house is move-in ready. It has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a lounge, a kitchen and a laundry room. Outdoors it offers a roof terrace of 27 m2 with views, a courtyard and a cellar or workshop. Heating comes from a wood burning stove and electric heating. Shops in the village are 25 minutes from Narbonne, 30 minutes from Béziers and 40 minutes from the beach. Asking €159,000, about €1,006/m².

item.title: €169,000 · Four-bedroom house with garden, garage and views in Mussidan, Dordogne
item.description: Mussidan, Dordogne. 166 m². RealHunt score 84. This 1970s house stands at the end of a dead-end street, built on a semi-underground basement. It offers 7 rooms, including 4 bedrooms and 2 shower rooms, across 166 m² of living space. The living-dining room has a balcony with a lovely view, and there is a fireplace. Outside, a fenced, tree-lined plot of 1,201 m² includes a garden and a garden shed of about 20 m². An attached garage of 27 m² adds parking, and the house has electric heating. Asking €169,000, about €1,018/m².

item.title: €159,000 · 4-bedroom stone house with covered terrace and garden in Piégut-Pluviers, Dordogne
item.description: Piégut-Pluviers, Dordogne. 161 m². RealHunt score 84. This 161 m2 stone house sits in a peaceful hamlet in the North Dordogne. It has four bedrooms, two bathrooms and an open-plan kitchen, living and dining room, with patio doors leading to a large covered terrace. Outside there is an enclosed garden, an attached garage and 6,781 sq ft of land. Electric heating is installed. It lies 3.5 km from Piégut-Pluviers and 5 km from Lac de Saint-Estèphe, a lake offering swimming. Asking €159,000, about €988/m².

item.title: €166,400 · Renovated 3-bedroom farmhouse with garden and countryside views in Le Busseau, Deux-Sèvres
item.description: Le Busseau, Deux-Sèvres, Poitou-Charentes. 170 m². RealHunt score 84. This renovated farmhouse is in good condition and ready to be personalized. It offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a kitchen, a living and dining room with exposed stone and beams, and a lounge with a pellet stove. Outdoors there is a garden with a well, about 2,200 m2 of land facing south, countryside views, a carport and a workshop outbuilding. Double glazing, 3 kW solar panels and an electric water heater are included. The home is 10 minutes from Coulonges-sur-l'Autize and 35 minutes from Niort. Asking €166,400, about €979/m².

item.title: €159,000 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom townhouse with fireplace and terrace in La Châtre, Indre
item.description: La Châtre, Indre. 150 m². RealHunt score 81. This move-in ready townhouse in the heart of La Châtre needs no work before you move in. It has three bedrooms, one bathroom, a shower room, separate toilets and a 45 m² living room with parquet flooring and a fireplace. An open plan equipped kitchen, a garden, a terrace, a cellar and 226 sq ft of land complete the home. Oil-fired central heating is installed, and all amenities are within walking distance. Asking €159,000, about €1,060/m².

item.title: €176,800 · Renovated 4-bedroom stone house with pool and views in Allonne, Deux-Sèvres
item.description: Allonne, Deux-Sèvres, Poitou-Charentes. 188 m². RealHunt score 85. Renovated traditional stone house in a quiet hamlet, with a terrace, a swimming pool and just over 700 m2 of land. Inside there are seven rooms, including four bedrooms, two shower rooms and a 43 m2 living room downstairs. The pool has unobstructed countryside views, and recent work covers the roof, septic tank, double glazing and shutters. Heating comes from an oil-fired boiler and a wood-burning stove. Secondigny is 5 minutes away, Parthenay 15 minutes and Niort 35 minutes. Asking €176,800, about €940/m².

item.title: €160,000 · Detached 4-bedroom farmhouse with garden and land in Plumieux, Côtes-d'Armor
item.description: Plumieux, Côtes-d'Armor. 190 m². RealHunt score 83. This detached farmhouse sits halfway between Josselin and Loudéac, in Plumieux. It offers 4 bedrooms, 2 on the ground floor, 3 bathrooms, a large farmhouse style kitchen, a dining room and a lounge with a wood burner. Outside there is a landscaped garden with fruit trees and a well, an old wood-clad shed, a large convertible attic, and about 8,255 m2 of land with south exposure. Heating is by wood, and Cambout is about 2 km away. Asking €160,000, about €842/m².

item.title: €140,000 · 4-bedroom house with garden and terrace in Uzerche, Corrèze
item.description: Uzerche, Corrèze. 115 m². RealHunt score 80. This is a house in Uzerche, a town with shops and amenities close by. The living area measures 115 m2 across six rooms, including four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Outdoors there is a garden, a terrace, a cellar and about 663 m² of terraced land, with an adjoining outbuilding that has direct access to the land. Heating is provided by electric convectors and a wood-burning stove. Asking €140,000, about €1,217/m².

item.title: €141,000 · 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and cellar in Noyers-Saint-Martin, Oise
item.description: Noyers-Saint-Martin, Oise. 110 m². RealHunt score 80. This 5-room house offers 110 m2 of living space on a 583 m2 plot. The ground floor has a dining room, living room, kitchen, bedroom, shower room and WC, and upstairs there is an office and two bedrooms. The property includes a garden, a terrace, land, a cellar and a garage. It has electric heating. Asking €141,000, about €1,282/m².

item.title: €138,000 · 3-bedroom house with cellar and double glazing in Mortagne-sur-Gironde, Charente-Maritime
item.description: Mortagne-sur-Gironde, Charente-Maritime. 101 m². RealHunt score 77. This three-level house in the center of the village has 101 m2 of living space. The ground floor has an entrance, a living room with electric shutters, and a kitchen and dining room of 32 m2. Upstairs there are three bedrooms and a bathroom with shower, sink and toilet. The house has a cellar of 14.25 m2, PVC double glazing and a new water heater. It has electric heating and no garden, with Meschers beaches 18.30 km away and Gémozac supermarkets 13.70 km away. Asking €138,000, about €1,366/m².

item.title: €152,000 · 5-bedroom house with garden and garage in Rostrenen, Brittany
item.description: Rostrenen, Brittany. 113 m². RealHunt score 79. This 7-room house of 113 m2 in Rostrenen has five bedrooms, a shower room and separate toilets. The ground floor includes an entrance with storage, a kitchen, a living room dining room with south-facing windows and a fireplace, and a bedroom. Outside, the plot of 1,071 m2 has a garden, a conservatory and an outbuilding, and the full basement includes a garage. Heating comes from a heat pump and solar panels, with double-glazed windows and mains drainage. The sea is about 50 minutes away. Asking €152,000, about €1,345/m².

item.title: €147,000 · 3-bedroom house with terrace, chalet and land in Luxey, Landes
item.description: Luxey, Landes. 115 m². RealHunt score 77. This 115 m2 house stands in the centre of Luxey, close to its amenities. The ground floor has a living room, an open plan equipped kitchen and a laundry room with toilet. The first floor has 3 bedrooms and a bathroom. Outside there is a 30 m2 wooden terrace, a wood shelter, a 437 m2 plot and a removable 25 m2 chalet. Heating comes from a wood stove and electric radiators, with hot water from a solar-linked tank and mains drainage. Asking €147,000, about €1,278/m².

item.title: €139,500 · 4-bedroom village house with garden and garage in Cercy-la-Tour, Burgundy
item.description: Cercy-la-Tour, Burgundy. 110 m². RealHunt score 76. This village house in Cercy-la-Tour has three levels, four bedrooms and 110 m2 of living area. It has an open-plan kitchen, dining area and living room on the ground floor, plus a shower room with WC upstairs. Outside, a garden of about 300 m2 includes an outbuilding with a garage and workshop, and the plot covers 4,036 sq ft of land. The Nivernais Canal and Aron River are within walking distance, and the house has central wood heating with electric backup. Asking €139,500, about €1,268/m².

item.title: €148,000 · Single-storey 3-bedroom stone house with terrace and garage in Bergerac, Dordogne
item.description: Bergerac, Dordogne. 110 m². RealHunt score 78. This single-storey stone house in Bergerac has period character and several improvements already made. It offers three bedrooms, a study, a separate kitchen and a living room with dining room. Outside are a fully enclosed 419 m² plot, a terrace, a garage and parking. A heat pump with air conditioning and a wood stove provide comfort. Schools and shops are nearby, but a busy road and railway line are close. Asking €148,000, about €1,345/m².

item.title: €149,900 · 2-bedroom period house with garden, land and outbuilding in Outarville, Loiret
item.description: Outarville, Loiret, Centre-Val de Loire. 110 m². RealHunt score 77. This period house in Outarville offers 110 m2 of living space, two bedrooms and one bathroom. The ground floor has an open-plan kitchen, a living and dining room with a fireplace, a bathroom and a separate WC. Outside you will find a terrace, a small garden, 3,154 sq ft of land and an outbuilding for storage or a workshop. A cellar completes the house, which has electric heating and recent double-glazed PVC windows. Asking €149,900, about €1,363/m².

item.title: €150,000 · Two-level house with land and attic in Peyremale, Gard
item.description: Peyremale, Gard, Languedoc. 123 m². RealHunt score 76. This two-level house in Peyremale offers 123 m2 of living space, with a kitchen, a living/dining room, an office, one bedroom and a separate toilet downstairs. Upstairs are two bedrooms and a large attic, and access between the floors is via the exterior only. The property also has a shower room, air conditioning and 6,566 sq ft of land. The home is heated by an air-to-water heat pump. Asking €150,000, about €1,220/m².

item.title: €149,900 · 4-bedroom family house with garden and land in Blaye, Gironde
item.description: Blaye, Gironde. 118 m². RealHunt score 78. This family house offers four bedrooms and a fitted, equipped kitchen across 118 m2 of living space, with two shower rooms. Its spacious living areas sit in a comfortable setting. The property includes a garden and 3,595 sq ft of land. The ground floor is fully accessible to people with reduced mobility, offering everyday comfort. It is around fifteen minutes from Blaye. Asking €149,900, about €1,270/m².

item.title: €149,900 · Detached house with conservatory, enclosed garden and garage in Chauny, Aisne
item.description: Chauny, Aisne, Picardy. 124 m². RealHunt score 78. This detached house sits very close to Chauny in a quiet area with amenities nearby. The ground floor has a fitted and equipped kitchen, a cosy living room with a fireplace, a large study, a sleeping area, a bathroom and a separate toilet, plus a light-filled conservatory opening onto the garden. Upstairs, two bedrooms include one of about 20 m². The enclosed garden, courtyard parking, a garage and an outbuilding complete the property. Living area is 124 m2 on a land plot of 6,889 sq ft. Asking €149,900, about €1,209/m².

item.title: €130,800 · Character 3-bedroom house with walled garden in Saint-Clémentin, Deux-Sèvres
item.description: Saint-Clémentin, Deux-Sèvres. 107 m². RealHunt score 79. This character house is arranged over three levels with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The ground floor has an entrance hall, an equipped kitchen, a dining room opening onto the garden, a shower room and a separate WC, with access to the cellar. The walled rear garden includes an outbuilding, and the property has a fireplace and 2,756 sq ft of land. It has gas-fired central heating, double glazing and mains drainage, and Bressuire is 15 minutes away. Asking €130,800, about €1,222/m².

item.title: €142,000 · Stone house with fireplaces and land in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
item.description: Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente. 108 m². RealHunt score 76. Stone house in one of the most beautiful villages in Charente, with exposed beams, stone walls, fireplaces and wooden floors. The ground floor has a 32 m² living room with a kitchen and wood-burning stove, and the first floor has a 20 m² bedroom with a fireplace. A 9 m² bathroom with bathtub, washbasin and toilet and a second bedroom on the upper floor complete the 108 m² of living space. The property includes 3,649 sq ft of land, with electric heating and a separate kitchen. Asking €142,000, about €1,315/m².

item.title: €134,500 · Village house with 2 bedrooms, fireplace and garage in Peyruis, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence
item.description: Peyruis, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence. 108 m². RealHunt score 76. This village house in Peyruis is arranged over three levels with two separate entrances. It has two bedrooms, a living room with a fireplace, a fitted kitchen and a bathroom with a laundry area. Features include a garage and two vaulted cellars, one below ground. It is a short walk from local shops and amenities, with quick access to the A51 motorway. The layout may allow division into two independent homes, subject to checks. Asking €134,500, about €1,245/m².

item.title: €142,000 · 3-bedroom house with garage and balconies in Valréas, Vaucluse, Provence
item.description: Valréas, Vaucluse, Provence. 115 m². RealHunt score 77. This 115 m² house is ideally located in the heart of Valréas. It has 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a 32 m² living and dining room, a kitchen and a utility kitchen/laundry room. Features include a garage, a private 20 m² outdoor area, a small balcony off the kitchen and a large balcony off the living room. Heating is oil-fired central heating, with reversible air conditioning in 2 bedrooms, and the home has PVC double-glazed windows and insulated attic space. Asking €142,000, about €1,235/m².

item.title: €139,100 · Country house with fireplace, garden and outbuildings in Bessé-sur-Braye, Sarthe
item.description: Bessé-sur-Braye, Sarthe. 105 m². RealHunt score 79. This country house in Bessé-sur-Braye has 105 m2 of living space, 2 bedrooms and 1 shower room. The living room has an open fireplace, and the ground floor includes an office, a separate WC and a utility room. The 22,454 sq ft plot includes a garden, a terrace, a garage, 2 parking spaces, outbuildings and an underground cellar. Heating comes from a heat pump installed in 2026, with double-glazed windows and doors. The house is 35 minutes from Vendôme TGV station. Asking €139,100, about €1,325/m².

item.title: €135,000 · 3-bedroom farmhouse with garden and cellar in Prats-de-Mollo-la-Preste, Pyrénées-Orientales
item.description: Prats-de-Mollo-la-Preste, Pyrénées-Orientales. 112 m². RealHunt score 80. This Catalan farmhouse in Prats-de-Mollo-la-Preste offers 112 m2 of living space over two floors. The ground floor has a dining room with wood stove, a living room, a kitchen and a storage room, while the first floor has 3 bedrooms, an office and a shower room with WC. The house faces south and sits on 35,295 sq ft of land. Extra features include a garden, a fireplace, a vaulted cellar, a paillère, an independent workshop and more than 190 m2 of annexes. Asking €135,000, about €1,205/m².

item.title: €145,000 · 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Quillan, Aude, Languedoc
item.description: Quillan, Aude, Languedoc. 114 m². RealHunt score 79. This 3-bedroom house with 114 m2 of living space sits in a quiet neighbourhood in Quillan. Its bright living room opens onto a veranda, and there is a separate kitchen, an additional sleeping area, two shower rooms and separate toilets. Outside you will find a landscaped garden, a terrace, 3,380 sq ft of land, and a garage with one parking space. Inside, a fireplace with a wood-burning stove, PVC double-glazed windows and gas central heating add comfort. Asking €145,000, about €1,272/m².

item.title: €134,400 · 3-bedroom house with garden, garage and large plot in Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente
item.description: Nanteuil-en-Vallée, Charente. 106 m². RealHunt score 78. This three-bedroom family house stands on a large plot in the Charente countryside. It has a fully equipped kitchen, a large living room with a wood-burning stove and a shower room. Outside are an enclosed garden with mature trees, a garage, a parking space and an additional plot. Heating comes mainly from the stove, supplemented by electric radiators in the coldest months. The village of Nanteuil-en-Vallée is five minutes away. Asking €134,400, about €1,268/m².

item.title: €127,000 · Wooden 1-bedroom house with terrace, views and land in Lorca, Murcia
item.description: Lorca, Murcia. 99 m². RealHunt score 80. This wooden house offers 99 m² of living space, one bedroom and one bathroom. It includes a fully equipped kitchen, separate living and dining rooms, and an enclosed veranda with a terrace. The 4.5 hectares of land offer panoramic views from every corner. The home has solar panels, butane gas heating and a current water connection to the neighbouring property. It is 10 minutes from El Consejero and 25 minutes from Lorca centre. Asking €127,000, about €1,283/m².

item.title: €147,700 · 5-bedroom house with cellar, enclosed plot and hangar in Huelgoat, Brittany
item.description: Huelgoat, Brittany. 121 m². RealHunt score 79. This house offers 121 m2 of living space across five bedrooms. The ground floor has a veranda entrance, a kitchen, a dining room, a double living room, a shower room and a separate toilet. Upstairs, one bedroom has a shower room and toilet, and another has a bathtub and toilet. The property includes a cellar, an enclosed plot of 3,900 m2 and a small hangar, with land designated for development by the municipality. The lake is close by, and the town centre is a 10 minute walk away. Asking €147,700, about €1,221/m².

item.title: €147,500 · 3-bedroom house with garden bordering forest in Mennevret, Aisne
item.description: Mennevret, Aisne, Picardy. 123 m². RealHunt score 80. This house sits in a peaceful cul-de-sac on the edge of the forest. The ground floor has a 31 m2 living room with a fireplace, a 16 m2 kitchen with forest views, a bedroom, a bathroom and a separate toilet. Upstairs, two attic bedrooms of 15 m2 and 18 m2 open off a 16.5 m2 landing. Outdoors there is a garden bordering the forest, a terrace, a small cellar, outbuildings, 8,396 sq ft of land and one parking space. Heating is oil-fired collective central heating. Asking €147,500, about €1,199/m².

item.title: €149,000 · 3-bedroom house with countryside views and guest bungalow in Vosnon, Aube, Champagne-Ardenne
item.description: Vosnon, Aube, Champagne-Ardenne. 125 m². RealHunt score 78. This south-facing house is built on ecological and bioclimatic principles and offers 125 m2 of living space. The ground floor has a living room with a wood-burning stove, an open-plan fitted kitchen, a shower room and a toilet. Upstairs there is an office area and three bedrooms. The 1,055 sqm plot is fully enclosed, has a chestnut tree and offers views of countryside and forest, and a large bungalow suited as a studio or guest house stands on it. The village lies between Saint Florentin and Troyes. Asking €149,000, about €1,192/m².

item.title: €139,000 · Detached 5-bedroom house with garden and covered terrace in Tergnier, Aisne, Picardy
item.description: Tergnier, Aisne, Picardy. 105 m². RealHunt score 77. This detached family house has 105 m2 of living space and five bedrooms, one of them on the ground floor. The ground floor has a bathroom with bathtub and shower, a separate toilet, a laundry room and an equipped kitchen, with a dining room and a bright lounge. Upstairs there are four further bedrooms and a study. Outside you will find a garden, a covered terrace, a small outbuilding, a courtyard with vehicle access and parking, plus a cellar and 4,284 sq ft of land. Asking €139,000, about €1,324/m².

item.title: €135,000 · Stone 3-bedroom house with terrace, land and garage in Saint-Martial-de-Gimel, Corrèze
item.description: Saint-Martial-de-Gimel, Corrèze. 110 m². RealHunt score 80. Charming stone house in the heart of the village of Saint-Martial-de-Gimel, close to amenities. The home has 110 m2 of living space, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, plus separate toilets, a kitchen opening onto a balcony and a bright living room with dining area. Outdoor and extra features include a terrace, land, a garage, a workshop, an outbuilding, a cellar and an attic. Heating is by wood stove, electric underfloor heating and reversible air conditioning, and the windows are double-glazed. Asking €135,000, about €1,227/m².

item.title: €185,000 · Villa with leisure area and parking space in Valhascos, Santarém
item.description: Valhascos, Santarém. 139 m². RealHunt score 76. This villa in Valhascos, Santarém offers 139 square metres of living area. It has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, an independent laundry, a technical room and a leisure area for family or friends gatherings. There is 1 parking space and room to build a garage. The village is quiet, 5 minutes from Sardoal and 15 minutes from Abrantes, with quick access to the highway. Asking €185,000, about €1,331/m².

item.title: €149,950 · 4-bedroom stone house with garden, garage and fireplace in Champagne-Mouton, Charente
item.description: Champagne-Mouton, Charente. 118 m². RealHunt score 77. Traditional stone house in a hamlet on the edge of a small village, 8 km from Champagne-Mouton. The ground floor has one bedroom, a bathroom and a shower room, and three more bedrooms are upstairs. The 878 m² plot includes a garden and a garage, with a fireplace and wood-burning stove in the living area. The house has gas central heating and double-glazed windows, and sits between Civray and Champagne-Mouton. Asking €149,950, about €1,271/m².

item.title: €139,000 · Townhouse with 3 bedrooms and terrace near station in Agen, Lot-et-Garonne
item.description: Agen, Lot-et-Garonne. 110 m². RealHunt score 76. This townhouse is built on two levels. It has an open-plan kitchen opening onto the dining area, a separate living room, three bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate WC. Outside, there is a terrace for outdoor meals and a parking space near the house. The property is close to Agen railway station, with shops, transport and schools nearby. The advert notes that it is suited to a first-time buyer or an investor. Asking €139,000, about €1,264/m².
